description: Parallelism ops view: CX* / memory-grant waits, active parallel requests with statement snippets, MAXDOP config, and triage guidance. Collector: mssql_parallelism (60s).

panels.description: Parallel / large-grant requests running now (elapsed >= 5s, DOP filter applied).

targets.expr: count((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active Parallel

panels.description: Instances with at least one active parallel request.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers Busy

panels.description: Highest degree of parallelism among active requests.

targets.expr: max((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max DOP Now

panels.description: Largest memory grant among active requests.

targets.expr: max((mssql_parallelism_active_request_grant_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Largest memory grant among active requests.

panels.description: Active parallel requests running longer than 1 minute.

targets.expr: count((mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))) >= 60000) or vector(0)

panels.title: Long >= 1m

panels.description: Requests waiting on RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE (memory pressure).

targets.expr: count((mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))) and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) (mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", wait_type="RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Mem Semaphore

panels.description: Wait types with CXPACKET/CXCONSUMER rate above 100 ms/s (5m avg).

targets.expr: count(rate(mssql_parallelism_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}", wait_type=~"CXPACKET|CXCONSUMER"}[5m]) > 100) or vector(0)

panels.title: CX Wait Hot

panels.description: Active requests with DOP 8 or higher.

targets.expr: count((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop) >= 8) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active requests with DOP 8 or higher.

panels.description: Stacked ms/s for CXPACKET, RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE, PAGEIOLATCH, etc. Rising CX* often means skew or MAXDOP too high.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_parallelism_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m]))

panels.title: Wait Time rate (by type)

panels.description: Scheduler tasks waiting on parallelism-related wait types.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_parallelism_waiting_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m]))

panels.title: Waiting Tasks rate

panels.description: How many parallel / large-grant requests per instance over time.

targets.expr: count by (instance) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))

panels.title: Active Requests by Server

panels.description: Peak DOP per server - spikes may correlate with batch jobs or missing indexes.

targets.expr: max by (instance) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))

panels.title: Max DOP by Server

panels.description: Elapsed = request runtime. Started = approximate start (now - elapsed). Sort by Elapsed or DOP.

targets.expr: max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, wait_type, statement_snip, dop) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))))

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, wait_type, statement_snip, dop) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_grant_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))))

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, wait_type, statement_snip, dop) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, wait_type, statement_snip, dop) (((time() - ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop)))) / 1000) * 1000))

panels.title: Active Parallel / Large-Grant Requests

panels.description: Bar view of the slowest active parallel requests right now.

targets.expr: topk(15, (mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))))

panels.title: Longest Elapsed (top 15)

panels.description: Requests consuming the most granted query memory.

targets.expr: topk(15, (mssql_parallelism_active_request_grant_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))))

panels.title: Largest Memory Grants (top 15)

panels.description: Which parallelism-related waits dominate right now.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (instance, wait_type) (rate(mssql_parallelism_wait_time_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", wait_type=~"${wait_type:regex}"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top Wait Types (rate ms/s)

targets.expr: count by (instance, db) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))

panels.title: Active by Program

panels.title: Wait Rate by Server

panels.description: What active parallel sessions are waiting on right now.

targets.expr: count by (instance, wait_type) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop and on(instance, session_id, db, login_name, program_name, dop, wait_type, statement_snip) ((mssql_parallelism_active_request_dop{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= $min_dop))))
